query.statement: SELECT PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, PLANT_ID, AREA_ID, EQUIPMENT_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_ID

INSERT INTO MDM_PLANT (PLANT_ID, PLANT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, COUNTRY, TIME_ZONE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@plantId, @plantName, @description, @country, @timeZone, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
SELECT PLANT_ID, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId
SELECT PLANT_ID AS VALUE, PLANT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY PLANT_NAME
SELECT AREA_ID AS VALUE, AREA_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_AREA WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY AREA_NAME
SELECT AREA_ID, AREA_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PLANT_ID FROM MDM_AREA WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY AREA_NAME
SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS VALUE, PRODUCT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_PRODUCT WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND (@productType IS NULL OR PRODUCT_TYPE = @productType) ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_TYPE, UNIT, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_PRODUCT WHERE (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY PRODUCT_NAME
SELECT CODE_CLASS_ID, CODE_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CODE_CLASS ORDER BY CODE_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CODE_ID AS VALUE, CODE_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_CODE WHERE CODE_CLASS_ID = @codeClassId AND VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CODE_NAME
SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID AS VALUE, EQUIPMENT_NAME AS TEXT FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_NAME

SELECT EQUIPMENT_ID, EQUIPMENT_NAME, PLANT_ID, AREA_ID, EQUIPMENT_TYPE, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@validState IS NULL OR VALID_STATE = @validState) ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_NAME
SELECT CODE_ID, CODE_NAME, CODE_CLASS_ID, SORT_ORDER, VALID_STATE FROM MDM_CODE WHERE (@codeClassId IS NULL OR CODE_CLASS_ID = @codeClassId) ORDER BY CODE_CLASS_ID, SORT_ORDER, CODE_NAME
SELECT EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_EQUIPMENT_CLASS ORDER BY EQUIPMENT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT ITEM_CLASS_ID, ITEM_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_ITEM_CLASS ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CARRIER_CLASS_ID, CARRIER_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CARRIER_CLASS ORDER BY CARRIER_CLASS_NAME
SELECT CARRIER_ID, CARRIER_NAME, CARRIER_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_CARRIER ORDER BY CARRIER_NAME
SELECT SEGMENT_CLASS_ID, SEGMENT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_SEGMENT_CLASS ORDER BY SEGMENT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT SEGMENT_ID, SEGMENT_NAME, SEGMENT_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_SEGMENT ORDER BY SEGMENT_NAME
SELECT PROCESS_CLASS_ID, PROCESS_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_PROCESS_CLASS ORDER BY PROCESS_CLASS_NAME
SELECT PROCESS_ID, PROCESS_NAME, PROCESS_CLASS_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_PROCESS ORDER BY PROCESS_NAME
SELECT ROUTING_ID, ROUTING_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_ROUTING ORDER BY ROUTING_NAME
SELECT BOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, COMPONENT_ID, QUANTITY FROM MDM_BOM ORDER BY BOM_ID
SELECT QTIME_ID, SEGMENT_ID, STANDARD_TIME, UNIT FROM MDM_QTIME ORDER BY QTIME_ID
SELECT ACTION_ID, QTIME_ID, ACTION_CODE, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_QTIME_ACTION ORDER BY ACTION_ID
SELECT WORKER_CLASS_ID, WORKER_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_WORKER_CLASS ORDER BY WORKER_CLASS_NAME
SELECT WORKER_ID, WORKER_NAME, WORKER_CLASS_ID, EMPLOYEE_NO, DEPARTMENT, PLANT_ID, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_WORKER WHERE (@workerClassId IS NULL OR WORKER_CLASS_ID = @workerClassId) ORDER BY WORKER_NAME
SELECT SHIFT_ID, SHIFT_NAME, START_TIME, END_TIME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_SHIFT ORDER BY SHIFT_ID
SELECT CALENDAR_ID, CALENDAR_DATE, DAY_TYPE, SHIFT_ID, PLANT_ID, DESCRIPTION FROM MDM_WORK_CALENDAR ORDER BY CALENDAR_DATE DESC
SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, CUSTOMER_TYPE, CONTACT_NAME, PHONE, ADDRESS, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_CUSTOMER ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME
SELECT DELIVERY_ITEM_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, DELIVERY_CODE, UNIT_PRICE, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_DELIVERY_ITEM WHERE (@customerId IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID = @customerId) ORDER BY CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID
SELECT LABEL_ID, PLANT_ID, LABEL_NAME, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_LABEL WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) ORDER BY LABEL_NAME

SELECT ISSUE_ID, PLANT_ID, LABEL_ID, ITEM_ID, LOT_ID, SERIAL_NUM, PRINT_CNT, ISSUED_AT FROM MDM_LABEL_ISSUE WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@labelId IS NULL OR LABEL_ID = @labelId) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT MAPPING_ID, PLANT_ID, PROCESS_ID, ITEM_ID, LABEL_ID, PRINT_LIMIT_CNT, PRINT_LIMIT_YN FROM MDM_LABEL_MAPPING WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@labelId IS NULL OR LABEL_ID = @labelId) ORDER BY LABEL_ID, PROCESS_ID

SELECT BOR_ID, PLANT_ID, BOR_NAME, PROCESS_ID, PRODUCT_ID, BOR_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_BOR WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@borType IS NULL OR BOR_TYPE = @borType) ORDER BY BOR_NAME

SELECT RESOURCE_ID, BOR_ID, RESOURCE_TYPE, RESOURCE_REF_ID, RESOURCE_NAME, REQUIRED_QTY, CONDITION_VALUE, IS_ACTIVE FROM MDM_BOR_RESOURCE WHERE (@borId IS NULL OR BOR_ID = @borId) AND (@resourceType IS NULL OR RESOURCE_TYPE = @resourceType) ORDER BY BOR_ID, RESOURCE_TYPE
